description: Two-hour Grand Prix on an outdoor karting circuit: safety briefing, practice laps, timed qualifying and a final race with podium ceremony.
Catered menu of traditional Málaga tapas, such as pescaíto frito, porra antequerana, local cheeses and cured meats, served at the client's venue. Vegetarian and vegan options; minimum 15 guests.
notes: Minimum 15 people. Vegetarian and vegan options

description: Informal all-day group menu at reserved tables in a café in Málaga's Soho district: gourmet sandwiches, seasonal salads, a sweet and one drink per person. Vegetarian options available.
Informal seated lunch on a beach-bar terrace at La Malagueta: salads to share, sardine espetos grilled over olive wood, seafood paella, dessert and house drinks.

Exclusive three-hour charter of a 20-metre catamaran along the Málaga coastline, with skipper and crew, cava and canapés, and time to unwind on the sundeck. Boarding by gangway; not adapted for wheelchair users.

Hands-on cooking class in teams led by a professional chef: prepare ajoblanco, a seafood or vegetable paella and a traditional dessert, then sit down together to eat what you cooked. Vegetarian menu available.
Unhurried, sommelier-led tasting of five Málaga D.O. wines, from dry whites to sweet Moscatel, paired with local cheeses and almonds in a historic city-centre wine cellar.

Return transfer by air-conditioned 55-seat coach with professional driver between any two points within 50 km of Málaga city, such as the airport, hotels or activity venues. Coach fitted with a wheelchair lift.
notes: Pick-up and drop-off within 50 km of Málaga city

description: Four-hour private hire of a hotel rooftop terrace overlooking the port and the Alcazaba, with lounge furniture, sound system and event staff. Step-free access by lift; catering not included.
Seated set dinner in the restaurant's private dining room: starters to share, a choice of main course and dessert. A vegan menu option, also suitable for vegetarians, is available.
Ninety-minute escape game for corporate groups: teams play parallel themed rooms and race to crack the puzzles and get out first. Not wheelchair accessible.
Traditional dinner in the main dining hall of a wood-fired asador: Castilian starters to share, roast suckling lamb or a vegetarian main, dessert and Ribera del Duero wine.
Cold buffet delivered and set up at your office or venue: sandwiches, wraps, salads, fruit and soft drinks, with clearly labelled vegetarian and vegan items.
notes: Delivered to the client's office or venue

description: Three-hour indoor padel tournament for mixed-level groups: warm-up clinic with a coach, round-robin matches in pairs, a final and prizes. Rackets and balls included.

service_name: Private guided tour of the Prado Museum (2h)
description: Two-hour private tour of the Prado's masterpieces by Velázquez, Goya and El Greco with an official guide and headsets; museum tickets included. Step-free route throughout.

Hands-on session with a professional bartender in a cocktail bar reserved for your group: learn the techniques behind three classic cocktails and shake your own, with alcohol-free alternatives available.
Air-conditioned 55-seat coach with professional driver at your disposal for up to five hours within the Madrid region, for transfers between hotels, offices and event venues.
notes: Madrid region only; up to five hours

description: Five-hour private hire of a 400 m² converted industrial loft with projector, sound system, Wi-Fi and flexible furniture for presentations, training sessions or parties. Step-free access; catering not included.
Two-hour guided kayak tour on the Guadalquivir past the Torre del Oro and Triana, with instructor, equipment and safety briefing included. Runs April to October only.
Reserved seating for your group at an intimate Triana tablao, the heart of Seville's flamenco tradition: a 75-minute live performance by singer, guitarist and dancers, with one drink per person.

service_name: Guided walking tour of Santa Cruz (2h)
description: Two-hour walk at an easy pace through the Santa Cruz quarter and around the Cathedral and Alcázar with an official local guide. Exteriors only; monument tickets not included.
notes: Exteriors only; monument tickets not included

description: Exclusive sunset charter of a panoramic boat along the Guadalquivir, with live Spanish guitar, Andalusian wines and montaditos served on board.

Casual set menu of six classic Sevillian tapas, such as salmorejo, espinacas con garbanzos and montadito de pringá, with one drink per person, at reserved tables in a traditional neighbourhood bar. Vegetarian options available.

service_name: Andalusian tasting dinner in a palace courtyard
description: Refined Andalusian tasting menu with sommelier-selected local wines, served in the arcaded courtyard of a restored 18th-century casa palacio, open-air in the warmer months and covered and heated in winter. Vegetarian tasting menu available.
Hands-on workshop in a Triana ceramics studio: learn the history of Sevillian azulejos and paint your own tile, which is fired and delivered afterwards as a keepsake.

Exclusive six-hour use of a restored 17th-century olive hacienda 20 minutes from Seville: whitewashed courtyards, gardens and a covered hall, with furniture, lighting and an event coordinator. Step-free access; catering and transport not included.
Air-conditioned 19-seat minibus with professional driver at your disposal for up to five hours within Seville and its province.
notes: Seville province only; up to five hours

description: Crews of up to six race keelboats, each with its own skipper, in a short regatta off Port Olímpic after a safety briefing; no sailing experience needed. Not adapted for wheelchair users.
Three-hour guided ride on electric bikes from the Gothic Quarter past Sagrada Família and Ciutadella Park to the seafront, with helmets and a refreshment stop.
Cook seafood or vegetable paella in teams under a chef's guidance, starting with a tapas aperitif and finishing with a shared meal of what you cooked. Vegetarian and vegan paella available.
Casual group aperitif in a traditional Gràcia bodega: house vermouth or a soft drink with Catalan tapas such as pa amb tomàquet, croquetes and patatas bravas. Vegetarian options available.
Seated dinner on a beachfront terrace in Barceloneta, enclosed and heated in winter: seafood starters to share, black rice or seafood paella, dessert and Catalan white wine.

service_name: Catalan tasting menu in private salon
description: Chef's seasonal tasting menu of modern Catalan cuisine with wine pairing, served in the private salon of an acclaimed Eixample restaurant. Vegetarian tasting menu available.

service_name: Airport to hotel coach transfer (one way)
description: One-way transfer by air-conditioned 55-seat coach between Barcelona-El Prat Airport and any city-centre hotel, with meet-and-greet at arrivals. Coach fitted with a wheelchair lift.
notes: One way only, between the airport and city-centre hotels

description: Exclusive five-hour use of the main hall of a restored Modernista palace in the Eixample, with stained glass, original mosaics, projector, sound system and stage for presentations or gala events. Step-free access by lift; catering not included.
Four-hour private hire of a beach club area at Nova Icària beach, open year-round: glazed indoor lounge plus sand-side terrace, with lounge furniture, DJ booth and bar staff. Catering not included.
